html:
The Maranganji, also called Margany or Mardigan, are an Aboriginal Australian people of southwest Queensland, in the country around the Bulloo and Paroo rivers near today's Quilpie.

Linguists describe their speech together with that of the neighbouring Gunya as close dialects of one language. Other neighbours were the Budjari, Kullilla and Wangkumara. Sheep and cattle stations reached this dry country in the 1860s and 1870s.
